digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Mutant count discrepancies (491 old vs 814 current in signing.py) prevent direct enforcement of stale per-shard ceilings without normalizing existing defects.

Shard promotion requires phased evidence gathering: advisory mode publishes findings without blocking, ratchet mode compares fresh base/head and preserves legacy survivors, strict mode requires all mutants killed or individually fingerprinted.
Manifest-authoritative timeout configuration (timeout_constant=1.0, timeout_multiplier=15.0) must replace repository-level mutmut config to avoid stale cache and guarantee per-shard evaluation.

Selector must map changed source/test/support files to shards, preserve both sides of renames, report unmatched Python tests, detect infrastructure changes selecting all shards, and emit sorted JSON for targeted or all-shard matrix jobs.

Per-shard 30-minute job limit with fresh isolated base/head archives, no mutation verdict cache retention, pinned Python 3.12 and mutmut 3.7.0, clean-test preflight, and always-published structured evidence enable deterministic regression detection and diagnostic-only reruns.
